dict.string: Sidevoice usa el micrófono para que hables con tus agentes durante una llamada.
Sidevoice can lower or pause Music and Spotify while your microphone is open or the agent is speaking in a call, and restore them afterwards.
Sidevoice lowers music and videos playing in other apps while your microphone is open or the agent is speaking in a call, and restores them afterwards. The audio is not recorded or stored.
